topics.title: Sakana AI ships Fugu Max & Fugu Ultra v2 — orchestration beats frontier models on price
topics.why: Instead of building one bigger model, Sakana built an orchestrator that routes your request across a pool of models — and Fugu Ultra v2 beat Anthropic's Opus 5 and Fable 5 on a visual-reasoning benchmark while undercutting frontier output pricing by 40-60%, a signal that routing, not raw scale, may be the next competitive edge.

topics.title: Temporal raises $550M at a $12.55B valuation as 'boring' AI infrastructure gets hot
topics.why: A company that just keeps AI agent workflows from breaking when things fail more than doubled its valuation since February, with revenue up 200%+ and customers like OpenAI and NVIDIA — a sign investors think the real bottleneck in agentic AI isn't smarter models, it's reliability plumbing.

topics.title: Anthropic researcher's public resignation over AI extinction risk keeps dominating headlines
topics.why: Jacob Coxon quit Anthropic warning labs are 'gambling with our lives' racing to self-improving AI, his post hit 100M+ views, and a week later it's still reshaping the safety debate — worth knowing since it's now shaping how policymakers and employers talk about AI risk.
